verdict.rationale: Grok Build has its own sign-in flow, including device-code authentication. Community reports say access is tied to xAI subscriptions, but only the top tier (SuperGrok Heavy) works; a $40/month subscriber was blocked at login. So signing in with an existing plan works only if that plan is the right tier. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing subscription sign-in and which plans qualify, support for lower-tier plans, and hands-on confirmation of a successful subscription login.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: `--device-auth` uses device-code authentication for headless or remote environments
